title: Orchestrate timed attestation, greenwave promotion and profile pin choreography
creator: Anika Rao
description: Build a CI/CD pipeline that performs cryptographic attestation of model artifacts, evaluates perf profiles against a greenwave policy, and automates time-windowed pin promotion to the runtime catalog. The flow should minimize manual approvals for low-risk model updates while preserving safe rollback and audit trails for enterprise customers. This ticket covers pipeline choreography, gating rules, TTL-based pinning semantics, and integration points for console rollouts and observability.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible CI job exists that signs model bundles and uploads attestations (cosign or equivalent) to the artifact store
Perf profiles are validated automatically against the greenwave policy (latency, p99, token-cost thresholds) and result in a pass/fail artifact status
A time-windowed pin promotion step can promote a model version to the 'candidate' catalog with TTL-based auto-retract if no manual greenwave approval is recorded
Automated roll-forward to 'stable' only occurs after canary telemetry (runtime perf/delta) satisfies configured SLOs and explicit promotion record is written to the release ledger
Every promotion/attestation action emits structured audit events that are viewable in Console and stream to the customer audit log endpoint
Pipeline has safe abort/rollback where a failed perf validation or signed-attestation mismatch halts promotion and flags the release for manual triage
implementation_notes: Re-use existing cosign attestation image from infra/cosign-bins, add wrapper that extracts model manifest + perf profile
Greenwave policy engine will run as a separate CI task with a JSON policy input; implement a compatibility shim so policies can be authored in Console UI later
Introduce a lightweight release ledger entry (timestamp, signer, profile-hash, policy-version) persisted to model-registry and exposed via API for rollbacks
TTL pinning: store pin with expiry timestamp; background reconciler reverts expired candidate pins and triggers alerts to the owning team
Integrate with Console rollout API to display canary metrics; add a 'promote' button that creates the ledger record and cancels TTL for that pin
Observability: emit per-step tracing spans (CI job id, artifact hash, attestor identity) and wire to tracing/metrics dashboard for SLA monitoring
risks: Automating promotion increases blast radius if greenwave policies are mis-specified; need conservative defaults and rollout throttle
Edge cases where perf profiles are noisy causing flaky pass/fail decisions; will require smoothing rules or minimum sample count
Compatibility: older runtimes may not honor TTL semantics; need guard rails to prevent premature eviction of pinned versions on older clusters
